import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect columns to ensure correct dtypes (optional but good practice)
    # Convert columns to expected types explicitly
    df_students = df_students.astype({
        'Student ID': 'int64',
        'student_name': 'string',
        'gender': 'string',
        'grade': 'string',
        'school_name': 'string',
        'reading_score': 'Int64',  # nullable integer
        'math_score': 'Int64'
    })
    
    df_schools = df_schools.astype({
        'School ID': 'int64',
        'school_name': 'string',
        'type': 'string',
        'size': 'Int64',
        'budget': 'Int64'
    })
    
    # Join the two sources on school_name to bring school info into student records
    # The target schema requires School ID, type, size, budget from source1
    # Source0 has school_name, Source1 has school_name and School ID etc.
    # Join on 'school_name' (string) because Student ID and School ID do not match logically
    df_merged = pd.merge(
        df_students,
        df_schools,
        how='left',
        on='school_name',
        validate='many_to_one'  # many students per one school
    )
    
    # Rename columns and reorder to match target schema:
    # Target Schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
    #                 'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    target_columns = [
        'Student ID',
        'student_name',
        'gender',
        'grade',
        'school_name',
        'reading_score',
        'math_score',
        'School ID',
        'type',
        'size',
        'budget'
    ]
    
    # Ensure all target columns exist after merge
    # If any missing columns, fill with appropriate nulls
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_merged.columns:
            if col in ['reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'size', 'budget']:
                df_merged[col] = pd.NA
            else:
                df_merged[col] = pd.NA
    
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Convert columns to final target dtypes explicitly
    df_target = df_target.astype({
        'Student ID': 'int64',
        'student_name': 'string',
        'gender': 'string',
        'grade': 'string',
        'school_name': 'string',
        'reading_score': 'Int64',
        'math_score': 'Int64',
        'School ID': 'Int64',
        'type': 'string',
        'size': 'Int64',
        'budget': 'Int64'
    })
    
    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
